arStrings.szText:
You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.

After making an enemy {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, your next direct damage dealt to them:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Heals you for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life
{icon:bullet,1.2} Generates {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Vigor
{icon:bullet,1.2} Removes the {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} effect
